clips.title: The story
paras: Ornery Ornery Galestriders concerns an orchard farmer in the Gustberry Lowlands struggling with a meager seasonal harvest. The local lowlands galestriders—larger and more vicious than their highland kin—have been raiding the orchard for stormapples and threatening the farm's livelihood. Culling the aggressive birds secures the remaining fruit while providing much-needed fresh tenderloins for dinner.

In the Gustberry Lowlands, local farmers face tough times following an already meager seasonal harvest. To make matters worse, wild galestriders have invaded the orchards, stripping branches of ripe stormapples and jeopardizing what little fruit remains. Keeping the farm viable means driving off or thinning out the boldest birds before the entire crop is lost.

Unlike their smaller and comparatively calmer cousins in the highlands, the galestriders of the lowlands are towering, bad-tempered beasts. Travelers in the lowlands must approach them with extreme care, as a single well-aimed kick from their powerful legs is enough to incapacitate or kill an inattentive fighter. Taking them down yields massive tenderloins that supply hungry locals with rare, substantial meals.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.
Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... Well, too long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
